title: Field Value Engineer (m/f/x)
description: Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Europe can reindustrialize if we bring together AI X energy market opportunities X industrial processes. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions with our Energy OS. Behind it is RIZMO: our autonomous AI agent acts as a digital colleague that builds independently, analyzes continuously, iterates with energy management and uncovers cost-saving potential. As a Field Value Engineer, you bring RIZMO directly to our industrial clients – with both feet on-site. You don't roll out a finished product; you actively build the engine: you train the agent with feedback from the field and make savings visible in euros and megawatt hours. Iteration cycles in hours, not quarters. Tasks Digital Twin: Build live models of entire energy systems – power, gas, steam, water, waste heat, generation and battery storage – including smart-meter and OPC UA integration. Decision Hub: Develop scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses and investment roadmaps together with our clients. Operation Hub: Support cross-site live optimization across day-ahead, intraday and grid services markets. Autonomous Agent: Make RIZMO better – parsing technical documents, researching parameters, running optimizations, finding cost reductions – and feed every insight from the field straight back into the engine. Commercial Ownership: Uncover unstated requirements from operators, plant managers and CFOs, defend business cases up to C-level, and measure your success in euros per unit saved. Requirements Education & Background: Degree in energy engineering, automation engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable STEM qualification. Energy Intelligence: You understand DACH/EU electricity markets (day-ahead, intraday, grid services), physics and thermodynamics, and how production processes interact with energy. Experience with OPC UA, Modbus and OT networks is a plus. AI-Native & Applied AI Engineering: You treat hallucinations as an engineering problem, have strong intuition for optimization and numerical models, and can convince even security officers of an agent's reliability. Maker Mindset (High Agency & High Ownership): You iterate fast, treat customer feedback as your highest-priority input, and deliver results instead of waiting for instructions. Language Skills: German at C1 level – most on-site work happens in German. If everything else fits but your German isn't C1 yet: apply anyway. Benefits Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education. Radical Performance Culture: Exceptional results get rewarded directly – with an uncapped OTE bonus of €5k–50k on top of your base salary. Seniority (junior to senior) is decided during the process, not by your title – don't be put off if you see yourself as more senior. Advancement is based on performance, not tenure. Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent). Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club. On-site Culture & Team Spirit: During your first year, you'll work from our office in Münster – that's where you'll get to know our system in depth and join the first deployments hands-on. After that, you'll work close to our clients in one of our industrial clusters (Rhine-Main, Rhine-Ruhr, Bavaria, Benelux). Not a customer success job, not 9-to-5, not pure algorithm development. Send us the thing you're proudest of – and what you'd most like to build next. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Data Sense & Engineering: Comfortable with long time series, unit and sign conventions; tests, version control, code review and CI are second nature. title: Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d)
description: Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 40 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin. Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d) to join our team. Your role Our engineering works in three product teams. Two of them build for our partners: one the portals, the other the API and our custody core. The third works inward, and you will own its product. Its mandate is to run Tangany's operations as efficiently as possible. Business and product operations processes such as transaction operations, billing, forecasting and KPI reporting get digitised, automated, or handed to AI agents where that is the better solution. Much of this runs today on a self-hosted Retool platform. Whether we keep extending it or replace it with an AI-native solution on top of the APIs our other teams provide is one of the first calls you will shape. The team works process-first. You map each process end-to-end with the people who run it, redesign it, and only then decide how it gets automated. The team's tech lead owns the engineering, and you own what gets built, in which order and why. Beyond your team, you are responsible for AI at Tangany: governance, enablement and tooling for the whole company. Who we are looking for You are a senior Product Owner who has shipped AI in a business setting yourself, whether LLM-based tools, agentic workflows or AI-assisted development, and you can explain what worked and what did not. You run discovery before anyone asks for it: you bring problems onto the roadmap that nobody requested, write your assumptions down before the build so they can be checked afterwards, and your specs catch the interaction that would break a neighbouring system before engineering finds it. When departments pull in different directions, you hold the priority and say no with a reason the requester accepts. You want to be measured by outcomes such as fewer manual steps, fewer iterations and lower cost per process. Tasks Own vision, roadmap and backlog of Tangany's Internal Operating System, the internal tooling every department works with, starting with the Retool-based operations portal. Map business and product operations processes end to end with Compliance, Operations, Finance and the other departments that run them and redesign them before anything gets automated. Decide per process whether it becomes an application built with AI-assisted development, an agentic flow, or a tool we buy. Back each decision with cost and benefit, then measure what the process costs before and after and report the result. Write specifications that engineering can build from without a rework round, including edge cases, what is out of scope, and the regulatory requirement behind each rule. Agree on the interfaces your processes need with the portal and API teams. Shape Tangany's AI strategy and own AI governance: usage policies, rules for which data may be processed by which AI system, and the approval of AI tools and vendors, in line with our obligations as a BaFin-regulated institution. Drive AI enablement and own the AI tooling for all employees. You train teams, run our internal AI programme, select and roll out the tools, and turn individual experiments that work into shared standards. Requirements Several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, including time in a senior role, ideally on internal platforms, operations tooling or process automation. Experience mapping and redesigning end-to-end processes with business stakeholders (BPMN or a comparable method) and automating them afterwards. Experience in a regulated environment, ideally financial services or crypto custody. You can tell a real obligation from a habit and design processes so that requirements under GwG, KWG, MiCA or DORA are met by construction. Knowledge of the EU AI Act is a plus. Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 40 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin.

Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d) to join our team.

Your role

Our engineering works in three product teams. Two of them build for our partners: one the portals, the other the API and our custody core. The third works inward, and you will own its product. Its mandate is to run Tangany's operations as efficiently as possible. Business and product operations processes such as transaction operations, billing, forecasting and KPI reporting get digitised, automated, or handed to AI agents where that is the better solution. Much of this runs today on a self-hosted Retool platform. Whether we keep extending it or replace it with an AI-native solution on top of the APIs our other teams provide is one of the first calls you will shape.

The team works process-first. You map each process end-to-end with the people who run it, redesign it, and only then decide how it gets automated. The team's tech lead owns the engineering, and you own what gets built, in which order and why. Beyond your team, you are responsible for AI at Tangany: governance, enablement and tooling for the whole company.

title: Werkstudent Data Operations & Reporting – Power BI, Excel, SQL (m/w/d)
description: Zur Verstärkung unserer Crew suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudent Data Operations & Reporting – Power BI, Excel, SQL (m/w/d) . Wer wir sind? Na, wer kennt uns nicht? Im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes sind wir in aller Munde. Unser Gewürz Ketchup - ja, der mit dem grünen Deckel - ist eine echte Legende. Aber wusstest du, dass wir noch viel mehr zu bieten haben? Mit über 600 Crew-Mitgliedern an zehn Standorten weltweit sind wir in der Gewürzwelt zuhause. Bei uns heißt es: Immer einen Schritt voraus sein, Herausforderungen spielend meistern & Genuss neu erleben. Genau diese Grundsätze machen uns zu einem zuverlässigen Lieferanten von hochwertigen Produkten in der Lebensmittelherstellung.   Deine Rolle: Die Brücke zwischen Rohdaten und Management-Entscheidungen Du brennst für Daten, Dashboards und Analysen, suchst aber neben Deinem Studium keine trockene Theorie, sondern echte Praxis? Dann bist Du bei uns richtig. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Data Operations & Reporting tauchst Du tief in unsere BI-Landschaft ein. Um es gleich vorwegzunehmen: Du musst nicht alles können – wichtiger sind uns Lernbereitschaft, analytisches Denken und eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise. Je nach Deiner Erfahrung übernimmst Du Aufgaben direkt eigenständig oder wir entwickeln sie gemeinsam mit Dir weiter.  Unser Deal Du bringst eine große Portion Datenaffinität, erste praktische Erfahrungen und sicheres Handwerkszeug in Excel und SQL mit. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Dir eine „Spielwiese“ mit echten Unternehmensdaten, auf der Du den Umgang mit Power BI, DAX und Datenmodellierung in der Praxis lernst und aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft mitwirkst. Klingt spannend? Dann nichts wie los! Werde Teil unserer Hela Crew & erlebe selbst, wie es ist, in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das wirklich schmeckt. Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns auf Dich! Hier gestaltest Du aktiv mit: Dashboards & Visualisierung: Du baust und optimierst Dashboards und Berichte in Power BI. Dabei erstellst Du Measures und KPIs (z. title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über Aampere Werde Teil von Aampere , einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert . Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo . Deine Mission Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %. Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt. Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft. Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt. Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet. Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung. Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir. Das bringst du mit Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut. Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen. Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war. Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären. Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert. Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren. Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen. Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus. Why Aampere? Startup Umfeld : jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren Persönliches Wachstum : Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen Tech : Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest. Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket : healthy team, happy team Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats) Offsite : bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next? Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im naheliegenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten - mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. Deshalb bist du mindestens vier Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office. ...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten. ...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. raw.description:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Seit unserem Launch ermöglichen wir EV-Besitzern einen schnellen & reibungslosen Verkauf innerhalb von 48h. Kaufende Händler aus ganz Europa haben Zugriff auf E-Autos von bisher nicht erschlossene Kundengruppen.

Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Sixt, Porsche, Mercedes, Enterprise und Cazoo.


Deine Mission

Wir bauen bei Aampere gerade eine Marke von 0 auf. Bisher kommen über 95 % unserer Kunden aus Growth Marketing und unsere Brand Awareness bei EV-Fahrern liegt bei ca. 5 bis 10 %.
Da wir eine starke B2C-Brand aufbauen wollen, wissen wir, dass wir früh in Brand investieren müssen. Wer in Deutschland ein E-Auto verkaufen will, soll automatisch an Aampere denken und wir suchen die Person, die das für uns umsetzt.
Die Strategie legst du mit dem Head of Marketing fest. Die Umsetzung liegt komplett bei dir, ohne Micro-Management im Tagesgeschäft.

Du planst die Kampagnen und führst sie auch durch. Du entscheidest Umfang, Region, Kanäle und Botschaft, von OOH über YouTube bis PR und Community. Nichts ist vorentschieden. Du testest Regionen gegeneinander und skalierst, was gewinnt.
Du bestimmst, wofür Aampere steht. Aus Research zu Kunden, Markt und Wettbewerb entstehen Positionierung, Narrative und Tone of Voice. Das Fundament gibt es noch nicht, aber die Research dafür würde schon gestartet.
Du denkst über Awareness Kanäle hinaus. Ein großer Teil unserer Brand Wahrnehmung entsteht während des Sales Prozesses. Du denkst vom ersten bis zum letzten Touchpoint der Customer Journey und sorgst in den richtigen Momenten für die richtige Message & Erfahrung.
Du bekommst ein sechsstelliges Budget. Wir planen ein festes Budget für Brand in 2027 ein. Wohin wir es investieren, liegt komplett bei dir.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine Brand von null mitgebaut. 4 bis 6 Jahre Brand-Erfahrung im B2C, Startup oder startup-nah. Du hast nicht ein bereits bestehendes System verwaltet, sondern eines aufgebaut.
Du denkst von Konzept bis Go-Live. Du hast Multi-Channel-Kampagnen bereits selbst konzipiert und live gebracht. Du weißt genau, wann welcher Kanal der richtige ist und wie wir unsere Message gezielt an die Kunden übermitteln. Du musst dabei nicht jeden Schritt selbst ausführen, sondern kannst auch auf externe Ressourcen zurückgreifen.
Du hast kreative Ideen und verstehst, weshalb sie funktionieren. Wir suchen die Person, die auf Sachen kommt, an die im Growth-Team niemand denkt. Zeig uns eine Kampagne, die es ohne dich nicht gegeben hätte und was danach messbar anders war.
Du baust das Fundament, nicht nur die Maßnahmen. Gute Kampagnen entstehen nur durch eine gute Grundlage. Du weißt, wie man aus Research eine Brand-Identity baut und kannst sie genau erklären.
Du bist ein Operator. Du führst eigenständig Audits, Feldbefragungen und Kampagnen durch. Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen und brauchst niemanden, der dich steuert.
Du denkst in Ergebnissen. Uns ist bewusst, dass Brand nicht 100% messbar ist. Trotzdem erwarten wir Outcome-getriebenes Handeln. Du findest heraus, wie wir eine starke, wiedererkennbare Marke bauen und erst Deutschland und anschließend EU-weit distribuieren.
Du bist AI-native. Eigene, kreative Ideen sind uns extrem wichtig. Für die Umsetzung solltest du allerdings AI allerdings als Hebel nutzen können, um Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
Deutsch ist deine Muttersprache. Unser B2C-Messaging findet zunächst in Deutschland statt. Gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.


Why Aampere?

Startup Umfeld: jeden Tag etwas bewirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Welt elektrisieren
Persönliches Wachstum: Im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du schnell aufsteigen und Verantwortung übernehmen
Tech: Ob Apple oder Windows, dein Laptop wird von uns gestellt. Du entscheidest, womit du am besten arbeitest.
Urban Sports Club und 58€ Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what’s next?

Wir verantworten u.a. das zentrale CRM HubSpot, über das alle Prozesse unserer Wertschöpfungskette laufen. Interne Software-Produkte integrieren sich genauso in unsere CRM-Infrastruktur wie spezifische Apps, z.B. zur Terminbuchung bei einer Kundenanfrage. Der nächste Skalierungs-Schritt erfordert einen noch stärkeren Fokus auf technisches Enablement unserer eigenen Organisation sowie den Ausbau und die Verbesserung unseres eigenen technischen Verantwortungsbereichs.

Du übernimmst dabei eine gewachsene, produktive Automatisierungslandschaft: Ein Teil unserer Geschäftslogik läuft heute als Custom Code direkt in HubSpot-Workflows, ein Teil in eigenen Backend-Services. Beides gehört dir – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich diese Architektur entwickelt.

Softwareentwicklung

  • Entwicklung TypeScript-basierter Automatisierungen und Services entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette im HubSpot CRM

  • Entwicklung von HubSpot-Apps und UI Extensions (React) für unsere internen Teams – von CRM-Cards bis Workflow-Actions

  • Verwaltung von Scopes, Token-Rotation, App-Versionierung und Deployments (CI/CD)

Automatisierungen & Workflows

  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von Custom-Code-Automatisierungen, die als Teil von HubSpot-Workflows laufen – inklusive Pflege der Workflows selbst (Trigger, Enrollment-Kriterien, Fehlerbilder)

  • Bewusste Platzierung von Logik: Du entscheidest, was in einen Workflow gehört, was in Custom Code und was in einen Backend-Service – und migrierst Logik dorthin, wo sie testbar und wartbar ist

  • Analyse und Behebung von Incidents in der bestehenden Automatisierungslandschaft, inklusive Datenkorrekturen und Backfills per Skript

API- & Event-getriebene Architektur

  • Einsatz der HubSpot CRM APIs für Objekte, Assoziationen und Batch-Operationen

  • Nutzung von Webhooks & Subscriptions für Event-getriebene Synchronisation

  • Aufbau robuster Retry-, Error-Handling- und Monitoring-Mechanismen – inklusive bewusstem Umgang mit Rate-Limits und Datenvolumen

Datenmodellierung & CRM-Architektur

  • Definition von Objektbeziehungen, Ownership-Logiken und Lifecycle-Zuständen

  • Sicherstellung von Datenkonsistenz über mehrere Systeme hinweg

Integrationen & Plattform-Strategie

  • Technische Anbindung interner sowie externer Systeme (z.B. Abrechnung, Metering, Energie-Backends, eigener Tech Stack)

  • Aufbau sauberer Schnittstellen zwischen HubSpot und produktiven Kernsystemen

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der langfristigen CRM- & Integrationsarchitektur – inklusive der schrittweisen Verlagerung komplexer Geschäftslogik aus Workflows in testbare Backend-Services



Dein Profil

Software-Engineering

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen, mit klarem Schwerpunkt Backend

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript; solide React-Kenntnisse für unsere CRM-Cards und UI Extensions (NestJS ist ein Plus)

  • Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, asynchronen Systemen, Queues und Event-Verarbeitung

  • Verständnis für saubere API-Verträge, Versionierung und Testing – du weißt, wann ein Pattern hilft und wann es Zeremonie ist

Systemdenken: Automatisierung & Skalierung

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit API- und Event-getriebener Integration von SaaS-Plattformen (CRM, Billing o.Ä.) – praktische Erfahrung mit der HubSpot Developer Platform (Private/Public Apps, OAuth 2.0, Scopes, Webhooks, UI Extensions) ist ein starkes Plus

  • Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer CRM- und Integrationsarchitekturen; du kannst HubSpot sinnvoll in eine größere Systemlandschaft einbetten

  • Bewusstsein für sinnvolle Automatisierungen, Performance, Plattform-Limits und Datenvolumen

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Assistenten und verantwortest das Ergebnis: Du entscheidest, was du delegierst, und reviewst, was zurückkommt

  • Unvollständig definierte Tickets schrecken dich nicht ab: Du willst wissen, wer ein Feature nutzt und warum, klärst offene Punkte aktiv und sagst auch mal Nein zu Features, die sich nicht rechnen

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe. We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch. As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands. Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions. Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory. You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations. You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements. You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially. You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets. Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products. Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management. Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing. Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand. Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe. AND WHY AHEAD? Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more) Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve) Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you! raw.title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
raw.description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!

title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
description: About us NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions. NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia. Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights. We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI. Responsibilities Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data. Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users. Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems. Turn data science insights into production-ready solutions, covering the full process from data analysis and modeling to well-tested, maintainable AI tools, including operationalization and MLOps. Develop and enhance machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and related use cases, and integrate them into the platform. Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, actively contributing to high engineering standards across the team. Research and experiment with new AI models, methods, and technologies, turning promising approaches into practical features and production solutions. Work closely with engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to develop effective solutions for real-world telecom challenges. Your profile PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a related natural science, with strong hands-on experience in mathematical and computational modeling. Minimum 3 years of experience developing software or machine learning systems in an industry or research environment, alongside or following your studies. Hands-on experience with AI agents and RAG, including building and implementing LLM-powered systems in practice. Strong background in data science and machine learning, with experience using tools and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and deep learning frameworks. Strong software engineering and programming skills, particularly in Python, with a focus on clean, well-structured, tested, and maintainable code. Good understanding of the design and development of agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tools, memory, evaluation, and guardrails. A strong research mindset and enthusiasm for keeping up with developments in AI and translating new approaches into practical solutions. Fluent English, combined with strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills. Experience productionizing ML solutions in the cloud, preferably AWS (e.g. Bedrock, ECS, S3), using modern AI and LLM tooling such as LangGraph, Chroma, FAISS, LangSmith, or Langfuse, including LLM evaluation, observability, prompt engineering, and cost and latency optimization is a plus. Exposure to telecom, networking, signal processing, or other data-rich technical domains is a plus. We Offer Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term. Opportunity to shape AI strategy in a fast-growing organization with access to state-of-the-art AI tools, infrastructure, and research opportunities Flexible working hours. 28 vacation days. Health & Sports Subsidy: Sports membership subsidy. Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy for a Germany-wide ticket. Bicycle leasing via JobRad. Regular Team Events. raw.title: Junior Customer Success Specialist (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Your mission

Purpose of the role

The Junior Customer Success Manager keeps single-store restaurants live, transacting and growing on SIDES. The role works a large book of scaled accounts, mostly through campaigns and signals rather than scheduled calls, and steps in personally when something moves: a store goes silent, a termination arrives, a customer becomes eligible for an upgrade.

It is the entry point into Customer Success. The role is built so that someone new to SaaS can learn the craft on clear processes, and grow into owning a book of their own.

Key responsibilities:

Activation and activity:

  • Follow up on new accounts from onboarding handover until they transact regularly, with a focus on the first 90 days
  • Work the silent-store list every week: accounts that are online in the CRM but show no transactions
  • Help customers adopt the modules they already pay for

Retention:

  • Contact every customer in the book whose termination arrives, within two working days, and document the reason
  • Run the first save conversation using the save playbook (pause, downgrade, fee removal, technical fix, discount last) and hand complex cases to a senior colleague
  • Clear the termination date in the CRM when a save succeeds

Expansion:

  • Run the evergreen upsell campaigns on the book together with Marketing, and follow up on responses
  • Qualify interest in SIDES Pay, webshop, loyalty and driver modules and close standard upgrades
  • Use tier and rate changes as the entry point for an upsell conversation

Day to day:

  • Answer customer success enquiries on the book in Zoho Desk and the CRM, and route pure support issues to Support without taking them over
  • Keep every interaction documented in the CRM
  • Flag recurring product issues to the Team Lead with ticket references

Your profile

Required:

  • First experience in a customer-facing role: customer success, account management, inside sales, support or hospitality
  • Clear, friendly and persistent on the phone
  • Organised enough to work a large book through lists and signals
  • Comfortable with a CRM and with numbers
  • Fluent German (DACH book) or Dutch (BENELUX book), good English

Desirable:

  • Experience in restaurants, delivery or retail
  • First experience with a SaaS product or payment product

Perks & Benefits

Our Benefits:

  • A recipe for success: With over a decade of experience in the gastronomy and delivery industry, SIDES is known as a true specialist in this field. Join a leading player and help shape the future of the market.
  • Ownership & impact: We give you the space to bring in your ideas, grow your strengths, and take real responsibility. You’ll work independently while being supported by a strong and collaborative team.
  • High-quality work setup: Modern hardware, ergonomic workstations, and a professional office environment ensure you can do your best work.
  • Hungry for growth: Continuous learning matters to us. Through regular feedback cycles, we actively support your personal and professional development.
  • A positive workplace culture: Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, a trusting team culture, and our well-connected office in the heart of Berlin (Südkreuz).

Workplace Environment Perks:

  • Central office location in Berlin
  • Regular office and team events
  • Snacks and drinks in the office
  • SIDES Library
  • Dog-friendly workplace
  • Onboarding lunch to help you settle in and connect with the team

Your Benefits:

  • €50 monthly benefit allowance - your choice:
    • JobRad
    • Deutschlandticket
    • Company pension scheme (bAV)
    • Wellhub
  • Urban Sports Club: Discounted membership with access to fitness, classes, and wellness activities.
  • Instahelp: Professional mental health support, available whenever you need it.
  • INCENT & Corporate Benefits: Attractive employee discounts and exclusive partner offers.
  • Hybrid work: A mix of office and home office, depending on your role and team.
  • Flexible working hours: Working hours that fit your daily life and offer real flexibility.
  • December 24th & 31st off: Fully off without deducting vacation days.

description: Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet. Who we hire today shapes who RIZM is tomorrow. Tasks Build tomorrow's team: You work directly within the team, design our recruiting structure together with us – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself. Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no. Make processes smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI instead of maintaining spreadsheets. Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials. Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships. Requirements Background: Degree in psychology, business, HR management, social sciences or something comparable – or a path that prepared you just as well. People sense: You spot potential even when it's not on the CV, and you can talk to engineers as equals. Tech affinity: You try out new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things more efficient. title: (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr (ÖPNV) Voll- oder Teilzeit / München/Hannover und/oder im Homeoffice
description: Gestalte deine Zukunft mit uns! Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in München suchen wir dich als (Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) in der Prüfung und/oder Beratung in unserem ÖPNV Team . Schon in der Beratung, Prüfung oder Private Equity tätig? Perfekt… Du hast (jahrelang) in einer Beratungs- oder Prüfungsgesellschaft, in einer M&A-Boutique oder im Private Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet, möchtest das gerne weiterhin tun, aber anders – z. B. ohne Arbeiten an Wochenenden und langen Arbeitstagen bis in die Nacht hinein? Gleichzeitig hast du Lust, dich zu spezialisieren, anstatt verschiedene Branchen nur oberflächlich kennenzulernen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen… Erfahrung in der ÖPNV-Branche? Muss nicht … Du kannst bei uns auch ohne bisherige Erfahrung in der ÖPNV-Branche starten – vorausgesetzt, Du hast Lust darauf, von erfahrenen Prüfern und Beratern zu lernen und interessierst Dich für die Mobilität von heute und morgen. Tradition und Beständigkeit – aber trotzdem nicht von gestern? Seit der Gründung der PKF IVT in den 70er Jahren sind wir ein verlässlicher Partner für große und kleinere Verkehrsunternehmen, Landkreise, Städte und Bundesländer in Deutschland und Österreich. Bei uns erwartet dich ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Wirtschaftsprüfern, Rechtsanwälten, Steuer-, IT- und Unternehmensberatern, das sich durch einen hohen Innovations- und Qualitätsanspruch kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt. Büro, Homeoffice? Beides gerne … Ob im Homeoffice oder vor Ort in München oder in Hannover: Hier richten wir uns ganz nach deinen persönlichen Lebensumständen! Aufgaben Nach der Einarbeitung übernimmst du in Abhängigkeit von deiner bisherigen Erfahrung die Projektverantwortung für Beratungs- und Prüfungsaufträge für unsere Mandanten. Du wirkst eigenverantwortlich z.B. an folgenden Fragestellungen mit: SPNV/ÖPNV-bezogene Sonderprüfungen, Unternehmensplanungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen, Controlling-Konzepte für Verkehrsunternehmen, Trennungsrechnungen zur Erfüllung beihilfenrechtlicher Vorgaben oder Überkompensationsprüfungen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld baust du ein tiefes Branchenwissen auf, entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kollegen neue Lösungen für unsere Mandanten und präsentierst deine Gedanken bei Veranstaltungen und in der Fachpresse. Bei Interesse wirst du ebenfalls eigenverantwortlich im Rahmen von Prüfungs- und Beratungsaufträgen für Mandanten in anderen Branchen tätig Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet. Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer Beratungs- oder Prüfungsgesellschaft, in einer M&A-Boutique oder im Private Equity-Umfeld sammeln. Ggf. bist du Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d) oder angehender Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d). Wir sind auch offen für internationale Examen, wie z.B. CFA, CISA. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in MS-Office (insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint) und kannst diese z.B. auch für Unternehmensplanungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen zielgerichtet einsetzen. Du überzeugst durch eine selbständige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und bringst Leistungsbereitschaft, Teamfähigkeit, Serviceorientierung sowie ein sicheres Auftreten mit. Benefits Du kannst dich auf ein Team freuen, das dir bei allen Fragen und Problemen zur Seite steht. Dein berufliches Weiterkommen liegt uns am Herzen: Deshalb unterstützen wir deine Wünsche nach Fort- und Weiterbildungen. Darüber hinaus fördern wir bei Interesse die zielgerichtete Weiterbildung, wie beispielsweise den Erwerb von Berufsexamina. Du kannst bei uns vor Ort oder im Homeoffice arbeiten. Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Familien unterstützt. Wenn du dich um deine Kinder krankheitsbedingt kümmern musst, zahlen wir dir bis zu fünf Tage im Jahr das volle Gehalt. Jedes Jahr laden wir Dich zu Festen, Ausflügen und Veranstaltungen ein. Weitere Informationen über unsere Tätigkeiten für Mandanten aus dem öffentlichen Verkehrssektor findest du auf unserer Website. Die Inklusion von Menschen mit Behinderung entspricht unserem Selbstverständnis und wir begrüßen daher deine Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung über unser Online Formular ! Bei Fragen melde dich jederzeit gerne. raw.title: Director / VP of Marketing (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Empower every employee.

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip is changing that.

Flip is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA, and Greif.

Our mission is backed by more than $85M in funding from leading investors including Notion Capital, HV Capital, and LEA Partners. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down on Flip with a new $25M round.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.


Job description

Help take Flip's brand and growth engine from strong to standout. Marketing is already one of our strongest growth channels, and we're ready to invest in a Director / VP Marketing to lead our entire Marketing team into our next phase of growth. You lead 10+ people across events, digital, content and design, working closely with our leadership team. Your two big levers: turning inbound into the fastest-growing source of new business, and building a brand people genuinely notice in a category where most companies look and sound the same. This role suits a leader who has built a brand-led growth engine before, brings both taste and numbers, and wants to shape a category that is still being defined, whether you come from B2B SaaS, DTC and e-commerce, consumer tech, B2B2C or PLG.

What you can expect

Scaling a brand and community that drives pipeline

  • A brand people notice in a category where most companies look and sound the same: human, employee- and customer-led, across social, video, website and events

  • Community and advocacy as growth channels: founder and employee voices, customers on stage, a creative rhythm that keeps the work fast, distinctive and measurable

  • Inbound as the fastest-growing source of new business, scaled together with our Digital team: website conversion, paid media, SEO and GEO, email nurture

  • One weekly funnel review built around SAO and cost per SAO, so Marketing is measured on pipeline, not MQLs

Team & operating rhythm

  • Leading three Heads and several senior ICs, and owning hiring and development as the team grows

  • A two-week sprint cadence and a weekly performance rhythm that the team owns

  • Representing Marketing in the leadership team and to investors, and shaping the marketing plan together with them

Pipeline, alongside Sales

  • Close partnership with Sales, BDR and RevOps on pipeline quality: SAO gate discipline, attribution governance and CRM hygiene

International growth

  • Marketing for our US expansion together with our international GTM lead

  • Preparing the funnel for product-led elements as our product evolves

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • A brand-led growth engine you have built, where brand, creative and performance worked together, with growth in inbound, organic or direct demand you can show and numbers you can defend

  • Creative velocity: fast, human, distinctive content and social work such as employee, founder or customer-led video, community, advocacy and weekly testing. Work that stood out, not campaigns that merely ran

  • Performance and funnel discipline: end-to-end ownership of paid media and website conversion, CAC and cost-per-outcome thinking, CRO, tracking and attribution literacy, and agencies managed against clear performance criteria

  • At least 3 years leading a marketing or growth function with budget ownership, including managing managers and an operating cadence you installed that ran on its own

  • English C1 or above and German B2 or above (C1 a plus), as most of our team and our largest market are German-speaking

  • AI-native ways of working across content, design and analysis

  • Willingness to travel to the HQ in Stuttgart (10–30%)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with a considered-purchase or sales-assisted motion, for example B2B2C, prosumer SaaS, high-ticket DTC or fintech

  • Experience building or contributing to a self-serve or product-led funnel

  • Familiarity with German enterprise buyers, HR, Operations, IT or Internal Communications decision makers, or frontline industries

What we offer you

  • A real mandate: Ownership of brand and growth for an entire company, seven-figure budget responsibility, as part of the leadership team.

  • Work mode: We're remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value in-person collaboration, which for this role means regular presence in our Stuttgart office, always with plenty of notice.

  • AI is how we work: Access to frontier AI tools is standard here, not something you request. We actively encourage heavy use across content, design, analysis and reporting.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • A team you'll actually meet: The whole company gets together twice a year (e.g. Stuttgart & Barcelona 2026), plus regular team events and culture days.

  • Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution. Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and real plant data. ● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical field. ● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical, hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing is highly preferred. ● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs, mass/energy balances and equipment sizing. ● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data into engineering models and decisions. ● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation, hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable. ● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical assumptions. ● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of industrial equipment or plants. ● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA. ● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering documentation and the actual plant. ● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering, Operations, suppliers and EPC partners. ● Fluent English; German is a plus. Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward increasingly larger and more standardized plants. The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts. You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it. performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and

technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and

title: Working Student Lead Generation (m/f/d)
description: Das sind wir Seit 2000 macht die ITA Logistics Group den Versand für Unternehmen einfacher, transparenter und effizienter. Mit unseren Plattformen LetMeShip und ParcelParcel können Unternehmen ihren täglichen Versand schnell vergleichen und direkt buchen. Dabei bündeln wir zahlreiche Versanddienstleister auf unseren Plattformen und kombinieren moderne Technologie mit persönlichem Service. An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten. Deine Rolle Deine 20 Stunden bei uns verbringst du vor allem damit, neue Unternehmen anzusprechen und erste Kontakte zu potenziellen Kunden aufzubauen. Dafür stellen wir dir bereits Leadlisten mit interessanten Unternehmen zur Verfügung. Gleichzeitig recherchierst du auch selbst, welche weiteren Unternehmen gut zu LetMeShip passen könnten, ermittelst die richtigen Ansprechpartner und greifst zum Hörer. Mal erreichst du sofort die passende Person, mal brauchst du mehrere Anläufe. Du lernst, Gespräche zu eröffnen, zuzuhören und echtes Interesse zu erkennen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen gut vorbereiteten Präsentationstermin für unsere Sales Manager zu vereinbaren. Dafür hältst du fest, was das Unternehmen versendet, welche Anforderungen bestehen und welche Fragen im ersten Gespräch aufgekommen sind. Im anschließenden Präsentationstermin übernimmt unser Sales Manager, stellt LetMeShip ausführlich vor, zeigt die Vorteile und Funktionen unserer Plattform und geht konkret auf den individuellen Versandbedarf des Unternehmens ein. Du gehörst zum Sales Team und bist dabei auch mit unserem Customer Service im Austausch. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest mit von uns bereitgestellten Leadlisten und ergänzt diese durch eigene Recherche nach passenden potenziellen Geschäftskunden und den richtigen Ansprechpersonen. Du greifst zum Telefon, erreichst die zuständigen Personen und stellst LetMeShip kurz vor. Du fragst nach den bisherigen Versandabläufen, verschaffst dir einen ersten Überblick über den Bedarf und erkennst, bei welchen Unternehmen echtes Interesse besteht. Du hältst die wichtigsten Informationen und Gesprächsergebnisse in HubSpot fest und sorgst so für eine gut vorbereitete Übergabe an unsere Sales Manager. Das bringst du mit Du bist immatrikuliert und kannst neben deinem Studium 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten. Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Hamburger Office arbeiten. Bei uns bedeutet hybrid: drei Tage im Office und zwei Tage flexibel im Homeoffice. Du möchtest Erfahrungen im Vertrieb sammeln und hast keine Scheu vor vielen Telefonaten mit unbekannten Menschen. Du kannst dich auf unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner einstellen und fragst nach, wenn du etwas genauer verstehen möchtest. Absagen gehören für dich zur Akquise dazu. Du gehst danach mit neuer Energie ins nächste Gespräch. Du organisierst deine Kontakte sorgfältig und drückst dich auf Deutsch mündlich und schriftlich sehr gut aus. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. BWL auf dem Stundenplan? Passt. Meeresbiologie oder zeitgenössische Puppenspielkunst? Passt auch. Für uns zählt weniger dein Studienfach als deine Lust, mit Menschen ins Gespräch zu kommen. Vertriebserfahrung sind für uns nicht entscheidend. Wir zeigen dir unsere Plattformen und geben dir das Wissen mit, das du für deine ersten Gespräche brauchst. Warum ITA Logistics Group? Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehört für uns auch der Einsatz moderner digitaler Tools und KI-Anwendungen, die deinen Arbeitsalltag sinnvoll unterstützen und Prozesse effizienter machen. Deine Vorteile 30 Tage Urlaub Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeiten Zeiterfassung & Überstundenausgleich Deutschlandticket oder Parkplatz-Zuschuss SpenditCard mit monatlich 50 € Guthaben Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Corporate Benefits Programm Workation-Möglichkeit Beratung & Unterstützung durch das Fürstenberg Institut Dein Start Ein strukturierter Onboarding-Prozess sorgt dafür, dass du dich von Anfang an gut zurecht findest. Du lernst Schritt für Schritt unsere Teams, Prozesse und Plattformen kennen und kannst dich schnell in deine neue Rolle einbringen. Mehr Informationen findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Werde Teil der ITA Crew Klingt gut? Dann freuen sich Felix und Björn auf deine Bewerbung inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Startdatum. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aller Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder Religion. Bewerber:innen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Mehr Informationen findest du unter www.letmeship.com . Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p>Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.&nbsp; Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.</p> <p>Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&amp;D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Systems Engineering bridges the gap between Riverlane and its customers. They act as the primary technical interface for our customers’ engineers to guide them through product integration and help with troubleshooting complex quantum systems. They are key to securing design wins and driving product development.</p> <p>As a Compiler Engineer, you will configure the software libraries and low-level code to run our custom DeltaFlow Hardware which connects to our customers Quantum Control Systems. You will work on creating predictable and stable low-latency, high throughput systems. You will use your knowledge and expertise to adapt our software to an ever-changing quantum control system to support scientists that are running quantum experiments.</p> <p>This is a fantastic opportunity to join Riverlane’s team, that is developing the world’s most advanced quantum error correcting algorithms.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Riverlane team is a mix of mathematicians, physicists and engineers, working together on a range of exciting and cutting-edge projects.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you will do&nbsp;</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong>Technical pre-Sales:</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Host Technical Workshops on Riverlane’s QEC Interface</li> <li>Evaluate Customers Control System and Data Communication requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">The deadline for applying to this role is Tuesday 13th October 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Job summary</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Within AISI’s Research Unit, the Agentic AI Risk Modelling and Mitigations team studies how advanced AI systems could become difficult to oversee, correct or shut down as they take on longer and more autonomous tasks. The team builds scenario-based risk models that extend published work on AI timelines and systemic risk and uses them to identify practical mitigations such as monitoring infrastructure, deployment guidance and containment protocols. Its analysis has been shared across government and is intended to inform real decisions by the organisations best placed to act.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are looking for a Workstream Lead to lead and line-manage this team through its next phase. You will shape the team’s strategy and research agenda, set the scientific direction of its work, and ensure that promising mitigations move from analysis into adoption. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can combine technical judgement, strategic thinking, delivery focus and strong people leadership in a fast-moving and highly consequential area.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role sits within AISI’s Research Unit and reports to a Research Unit Deputy Director.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Job description</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Workstream Lead for Agentic AI Risk Modelling and Mitigations, you will provide the scientific, strategic and managerial leadership needed to keep the team at the forefront of this area.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will be accountable for the team’s research agenda and for the routes to implementation of any mitigations it identifies. This includes setting priorities, choosing analytical approaches, reviewing the quality of outputs, and ensuring the work is relevant to the institutions that can act on it. You will also lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, oversee multiple strands of work at once, and build strong relationships with senior policy and technical stakeholders across government, research organisations and frontier AI companies.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The team’s aim for March 2027 is for the UK organisations best placed to act to have adopted its existing mitigations, and for newly identified mitigations to move more quickly from research to adoption.
