Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our&nbsp;<u><a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.civil-service-careers.gov.uk%2Fartificial-intelligence-and-recruitment%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CLynn.Tan%40dsit.gov.uk%7Ccf5d753b7f19427afc8f08de4c307014%7Ccbac700502c143ebb497e6492d1b2dd8%7C0%7C0%7C639031968075235036%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=jCrYoy62YfXN%2FLIB%2FhtHxdLGbCOgropbkZXDyQsUMC4%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="02db05e7-03ca-4ca6-bcd9-73ff8bf258f2" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-linkindex="1">candidate guidance&nbsp;</a></u>for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.</span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><strong>Internal Fraud Database</strong>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">For more information please see -&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice">Internal Fraud Register.</a></span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Security</span></h3> <span style="font-size: 8pt;">Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" data-sk="tooltip_parent">baseline personnel security standard (BPSS)&nbsp;clearance</a>&nbsp;before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-security-vetting-advice-for-people-who-are-being-vetted" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-security-vetting-advice-for-people-who-are-being-vetted" data-sk="tooltip_parent">counter-terrorist check (CTC)&nbsp;clearance</a>. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement.&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vetting-explained-and-our-vetting-charter/the-vetting-charter" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vetting-explained-and-our-vetting-charter/the-vetting-charter" data-sk="tooltip_parent">See our vetting charter here.</a></span></div> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Nationality requirements</span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">We may be able to offer roles to applicant from <strong>any nationality or background</strong>. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard <a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules" target="_blank">nationality requirements (opens in a new window).</a></span></p> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Working for the Civil Service</span></h3> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The&nbsp;<a href="http://civilservicecommission.independent.gov.uk/code/" target="_blank">Civil Service Code (opens in a new window)</a> sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.&nbsp;The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.&nbsp;The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.</span></div> </div> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Diversity and Inclusion</span></h3> <div class="vac_display_field_value"><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/civil-service-people-plan-2024-2027/civil-service-people-plan-2024-2027-html" target="_blank">Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window)</a>&nbsp;and the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/civil-service-diversity-and-inclusion-strategy-2022-to-2025" target="_blank">Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window)</a>. As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&amp;I. You can see how we process this data here: <a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-digital-service-recruitment-privacy-notice/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK</a>.</span></div> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">For more information please see -&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice">Internal Fraud Register.</a></span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Security</span></h3> <span style="font-size: 8pt;">Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" data-sk="tooltip_parent">baseline personnel security standard (BPSS)&nbsp;clearance</a>&nbsp;before they can be appointed. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement.&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vetting-explained-and-our-vetting-charter/the-vetting-charter" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vetting-explained-and-our-vetting-charter/the-vetting-charter" data-sk="tooltip_parent">See our vetting charter here.</a></span></div> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Nationality requirements</span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">We may be able to offer roles to applicant from <strong>any nationality or background</strong>. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard <a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules" target="_blank">nationality requirements (opens in a new window).</a></span></p> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Working for the Civil Service</span></h3> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The&nbsp;<a href="http://civilservicecommission.independent.gov.uk/code/" target="_blank">Civil Service Code (opens in a new window)</a> sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.&nbsp;The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. title: People Partner Lead, Corporate Functions, Product & Tech
description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. About Neko Health Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Our mission is to redesign healthcare by shifting the focus from reactive treatment to proactive and preventive care. We are building a new kind of healthcare experience designed to help people stay ahead of their health. By combining medical expertise with breakthrough technology, we make it possible to quickly and non-invasively gather a broad picture of a person's health and deliver clear insights within minutes. Headquartered in Stockholm and New York, Neko Health offers the Neko Body Scan experience across Europe and the US, supported by a growing team of people working to transform how healthcare is delivered. Why this role exists Legal, Finance and People are what let Neko operate, hire and stay compliant as it scales, and Product & Technology is the largest, most complex function at HQ. These aren't the same kind of problem. Each function sits at a different stage of maturity, and this role isn't about pulling them into one shape. It's about moving fluidly between genuinely different disciplines, bringing the right kind of people practice to each, rather than defaulting to a single playbook. This is one of the most senior People roles at HQ outside the Global People Lead itself. It suits a senior level HR operator who's genuinely comfortable holding several different kinds of problem at once, and who brings real depth in organisational design, workforce planning, strategy and culture, genuine command of each rather than surface-level familiarity. What you'll do Own the people agenda across Corporate Functions and partners with the Global People lead on parts of the Product & Tech organisation Lead workforce planning and organisational design across Legal, Finance, People, (and support to parts of the Product & Technology teams) role clarity, resourcing decisions and structural recommendations tailored to each function's stage Meet each function on its own terms, building where a function is still finding its shape, optimising where it's stable, rather than applying one approach everywhere Build genuine partnership with the leaders who run each of these teams, calibrating the relationship to what each one needs Be the strategic partner to senior leadership Serve as the primary strategic partner across Legal, Finance, People and some of the Product & Technology teams, translating business strategy into people priorities, programmes and operating plans for each function Coach and challenge leaders on the decisions that shape the organisation they'll be running next year, thinking a step ahead of today's priorities Bring sound judgement and discretion to the most sensitive people matters across all four functions Champion Neko's culture and Vitals Partner with leaders across Legal, Finance, People and parts of the Product & Technology to embed Neko's cultural Vitals into how their teams actually operate, day to day Help leaders translate the Vitals into practical behaviours and decisions across genuinely different functions Build the rituals and feedback loops that keep culture genuinely lived as each function matures at its own pace Drive talent management across Corporate Functions and Product & Tech Working in partnership with the Growth & Engagement team to drive leadership development, performance and engagement for the leadership population across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology Advise on compensation, mobility and promotions in partnership with Reward & Enablement, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness across genuinely different functions Lead change and manage risk Lead and sponsor change initiatives that affect structure or operating model in any of these functions, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement and change readiness from start to finish Manage employee relations matters across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology, working directly with Legal colleagues and specialist counsel to resolve issues with discretion and confidentiality Spot risk early, whether that's capacity strain in Legal or Finance, or Product & Technology's pace outstripping its structure Drive organisational design and workforce planning Use workforce and org data to shape decisions ahead of need Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that turn data into clear, decision-ready recommendations Put data and AI to work in how the people agenda runs day to day, sharper decisions, less manual effort Bring the right practice to functions at different stages Recognise that Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology each need different structures, rhythms and support, and build accordingly Turn central People programmes into practice that fits each function's actual culture and maturity Experience evaluating how AI informs talent decisions and org design, bringing the judgement to design with AI as a genuine participant in how roles and structures should look, actively shaping the work itself. What you bring Deep, hands-on experience across organisational design, workforce planning, people strategy and culture, genuine depth in all four, built through direct ownership rather than generalist HRBP exposure 10+ years in senior HR Business Partner, People Partner, or People/HR leadership roles, including ownership of the people agenda across genuinely different functions at Director level or above Experience owning leadership development and performance calibration outcomes for a senior leadership population A track record of personally leading change initiatives end to end: scope, timeline, and stakeholder engagement A genuine passion for culture and values, with experience helping leaders embed them into how their teams actually work A track record of partnering with and influencing senior functional leaders on complex, high-stakes organisational decisions, operating with genuine autonomy as an independent decision-maker Comfort holding functions at very different stages of maturity at once, adapting approach rather than applying one framework to all Fluent with people data and actively using AI in your own work Working knowledge of employment law relevant to Neko's HQ locations, with the judgement to know when to bring in specialist expertise About Titles at Neko We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market-facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process. Hiring Process Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews, culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team. Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Documented, current breast ultrasound practice, with a minimum of two years’ full-time-equivalent breast scanning.

  • Advanced radiographic experience of reporting autonomously within the NHS Breast Screening Programme (NHSBSP) or an equivalent quality-assurance framework.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to study participants.

  • Commitment to maintaining high clinical standards and engaging in ongoing professional development.

Preferred

  • Experience with previous ultrasound scanning as part of clinical trials

  • Experience with shear-wave elastography acquisition and reporting.

title: Lead Product Manager
description: Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption. We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce. Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance. In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn. But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output. Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. The Opportunity We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster. The Role We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams. Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps. As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office. What You'll Own AI-native product experiences Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development. Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users. Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction. Prescription and eligibility Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost. Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild. Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge. Recommendation, commitment and finalisation Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting. Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap. Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start. Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel. Metrics and experimentation Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails. Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation. Cross-functional Leadership Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable. Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points. Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch. Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership. What We're Looking For The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context . You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner. Must-have experience: Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation). Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards. Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments. Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies. Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts. Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content. AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies. The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.

What You'll Own

AI-native product experiences

  • Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

  • Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

  • Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

  • Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

  • Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

  • Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

  • Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

  • Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

  • Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

  • Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

  • Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

  • Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

  • Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

  • Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

  • Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

  • Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

  • Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

  • Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

  • Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

  • Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

  • Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

  • AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies.

Strong signals we look for:

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

  • Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

  • Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

  • A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

  • A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

  • Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on a product that genuinely changes economic trajectories.

  • A team that takes craft seriously and holds a high bar.

  • Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over product direction.

  • A place in a company rebuilding itself as product-powered and AI-native, where you help define the result rather than inherit it.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

  • ION Corporates: Provider for the digital corporation, enabling automation of workflows across critical treasury and commodities operations.

  • ION Core Banking: Provider of core banking and financial software for financial institutions in Italy and internationally.
  • ION Insight Score: Provider of credit information and credit management in Italy.
  • ION Risk Metrics: Provider of credit servicing and asset management in Italy. 
 
Our Programme
 
Our Leadership Development Program (LDP) is a foundational global initiative focused on developing talent for ION’s growing operations around the world. The program provides an opportunity for outstanding university graduates to start a career in a dynamic and fast paced global FinTech firm.
 
Analysts will spend the first 3 years of their career in 3 unique, 12-month rotations gaining experience across the product lifecycle. At the end of their 3 rotations analysts will transition to a deeper dive in one area of ION. 
 
 
What you'll do

In the role of Software Developer, you will develop products for our global customers including Tier 1 banks and Fortune 100 corporations. You will be part of an Agile team, who are responsible for end-to-end product development, including: 

  • Analyzing business requirements and product solutioning. 

  • Architecture and designs using the latest principles and patterns in software engineering. 

  • Coding, testing, and continuous integration of solutions using the latest and upcoming technologies. 

 
Your Contribution

  • Build innovative products and solutions that: 

    • Reduce business process complexity.
    • Increase organizational efficiency through automation.
    • Liberate people from performing repetitive manual tasks.
    • Help ION’s clients gain a competitive advantage by using our products. 

  • Resolve complex technical and business issues and communicate effectively to Internal teams and ION clients. 

  • Automate complex business workflows and processes and make a positive impact to client businesses. 

 
Basic Qualifications

  • 2027 graduation. 

  • 2:1 or above. 

  • Bachelor’s, or Master’s, in Computer Science or related STEM disciplines, such as Data Science, or Quantitative Finance, with experience in hands-on programming required. 

  • Authorization to work in selected countries without restriction or need for sponsorship. 

  • Demonstrated interest in finance and/or technology, ideally including work experience. 

  • Passion for learning, self-improvement, and a questioning and challenging mindset. 

  • Motivated self-starter who is proactive, enthusiastic, and passionate about what they do. 

  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and the desire to understand the “why” behind each problem.

 
How you'll grow
 

Our 36-month Leadership Development Program (LDP) allows you to rotate through different areas of the product lifecycle. You will work closely with ION product teams, and clients, and grow, gaining: 

  • Deep knowledge in:

    • Diverse set of technologies, development methodologies, and processes required to build complex mission-critical systems using distributed architectures.

    • Financial domain to build world class products. 

  • E2E Software Product Development Lifecycle. 

  • A mastery of foundational technologies, keeping on top of constant technological evolution through your work with subject matter experts. 

  • Personality traits in an Imaginative and Positive culture:

    • Passionate. 

    • Expressive.

    • Intelligent. 

  • Exposure to: 

    • Product Management. 

    • Client Services. 

    • Support. 

    • Deployment. 

Application process

Applicants that submit successful online applications will be required to complete an assessment within 4 days of receiving the test link.

Successful applicants will subsequently be invited to a video interview.

The final part of the process is an assessment day at our London office, consisting of interviews, a case study and a group exercise.

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as you are ready because initial video interviews can occur prior to the application period closing.

We aim to notify you of your application status approximately one or months after we receive your application.

Final assessment day will be confirmed later.

Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The Team

Credit Cards is focused on creating distinctive products and growing profitably. The Originations team owns the experience and capabilities that take a customer from a customer’s first interaction with Zopa through application, decisioning and onboardingbringing together engineering, credit, fraud operations and partners. 

 As Senior Product Manager, you will own the Originations product and its performance — driving profitable new-account growth, conversion and customer experience from a customer’s first interaction with Zopa through to onboarding. You’ll partner closely with Credit, who own credit strategy, customer selection and pricing. 


A day in the life:

  • Set the direction and roadmap for Credit Cards Originations from a customer’s first interaction with Zopa through application and onboarding. 

  • Use customer, commercial and risk signals to identify the biggest product opportunities to improve profitable new-account growth.

  • artner with Credit and Fraud to build and evolve the capabilities behind eligibility, affordability, decisioning, pricing and fraud prevention. Credit owns credit strategy, customer selection and pricing; you own how these are translated into scalable product capabilities and customer experiences. 

  • Lead the product direction for a squad of engineers and work closely with shared decisioning, design, analytics and operations colleagues. 

  • Improve conversion by simplifying journeys, reducing avoidable referrals and testing web and in-app changes. 

  • Shape partnerships and data opportunities, including open-banking and third-party propositions. 

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs across customer outcomes, conversion, economics, risk, quality and delivery speed. 

  • Develop the team’s ways of working, including practical use of AI and automation to improve productivity, speed and quality. productivitiy and effectiveness. 


About you:

  • You have owned measurable commercial and customer outcomes across a complex digital product area. 

  • You can turn ambiguous problems into a clear direction, prioritised roadmap and well-defined measures of success. 

  • You bring sound commercial judgement and can balance growth, conversion, unit economics, customer outcomes and risk considerations. 

  • You are comfortable being accountable for clear goals and KPIs, and changing course when the evidence shows the current plan is not working. 

  • You build strong product-engineering partnerships and lead work end to end, from problem definition and discovery through launch, measurement and iteration. 

  • You use data to form hypotheses, make decisions and explain what you chose not to do. 

  • You influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners without relying on hierarchy. 

  • You are hands-on, decisive and comfortable getting into the detail when needed. 

  • You continually improve how a team works and are open to using AI and automation thoughtfully. 


Added bonus

  • Experience in consumer fintech or a fast-moving, customer-facing scale-up. 

  • Comfortable working directly with data using SQL, scripting languages and BI / analytical tools where needed. 

  • Experience developing or coaching product managers or analysts. 

  • Experience of third-party data, open banking or strategic partner propositions. 

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

 

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

The Role

At Opencast, we love to keep things simple, and we love automation. 
 
It’s not the same as your standard DevOps Consultant job. Depending on your client’s needs, you’ll take on a range of roles. These will include: 
  • Taking the lead on responding to outages, triaging issues, balancing stakeholder priorities/concerns, and keeping communication channels open with all parties. 
  • Developing, and implementing continuous deployment solutions that help our clients to deliver software faster and more efficiently. 
  • Collaborating with our clients to understand their ways of working and will have an enthusiasm to learn new tools and technologies as needed. 
  • Contributing within Opencast communities.
  • Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client. 
We care about building things right. We believe in good DevOps practices and keeping things simple. We want to support you as much as we can on interiorising our approach to DevOps engineering and you supporting others. 
 
We are proud consultants who combine our own experience and approach with our company values. 
 
We are comfortable with new tech. We are empowered, cloud native, vendor agnostic DevOps engineers. We are empathetic, patient and care about quality.

We’re always willing to teach and help others (inside or outside of our team). And we’re always willing to learn. 
 
It’s a varied job that keeps you super technical and excited.

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements. 

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

  • Create, modify, and maintain complex CI/CD pipelines.

  • Use automated testing to detect security issues/vulnerabilities in application and/or infrastructure code, thereby detecting issues before it reaches production (aka Shift-Left).

  • Positively challenge decisions or solutions you don't agree with, striving for the best client outcome.
  • Create lasting value in the projects you work on, ensuring a user-centric, sustainable approach. 
  • Engage with Opencast in a meaningful way, supporting the growth of your practice and wider capability. 
  • Support Opencast's growth plans, by providing case studies and updates into the relevant forums of your project work.

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is worth the tradeoff. Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for tens of millions of people. Represent engineering to the company. Wave is very transparent, whether that's defaulting to public conversations in slack, frequent Ask Wave Anything sessions, or defaulting to writing public docs to explain major decisions. You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data. description: <p>Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. Its integrity depends on proctors making accurate, consistent, and defensible decisions — even when sessions present ambiguous evidence or new forms of cheating. You’ll define what “correct” looks like, run our calibration and adjudication program, and build ongoing training that measurably improves decision quality. You will partner with Psychometrics, Security, Operations, Product, and Engineering to ensure our human and AI-assisted workflows meet rigorous accuracy standards before and after deployment. This is an individual-contributor role within DET Proctoring Operations, with functional leadership over Training Specialists and adjudicators executing the program.</p> <p><strong>🧠&nbsp; You will...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the DET proctoring quality standard — maintain rubrics, decision rules, examples, and guidance that define accurate decisions across routine and difficult edge cases.</li> <li>Lead calibration and adjudication — operate recurring Proctor Certification Test cycles, resolve disputed decisions, identify patterns of disagreement, and ensure outcomes are consistent and auditable.</li> <li>Build and run an ongoing learning program — publish a forward-looking training calendar, deliver monthly interventions, and launch targeted training in response to quality signals, threats, or workflow changes.</li> <li>Measure effectiveness — use calibration results, audits, and performance trends to identify learning needs, evaluate training impact, and decide when to clarify standards, retrain, or update guidance.</li> <li>Guide specialist execution — set expectations for Training Specialists and adjudicators, assign deliverables, review outputs, and operate onboarding and certification that ramp new specialists quickly.</li> <li>Maintain durable sources of truth — keep calibration, adjudication, and training runbooks current so critical processes are documented and auditable.</li> <li>Evolve quality alongside proctoring — translate new threats and workflow changes into clear standards, training, and quality controls in partnership with Psychometrics, Security, Operations, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li>Represent the proctoring craft — bring frontline proctor evidence into product experiments and workflow decisions; assess whether launched changes preserve decision quality.</li> <li>Connect human and technology-assisted quality — establish benchmarks for AI-assisted workflows and validate automated capabilities against real sessions before deployment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>✅&nbsp; You have...</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in assessment development, scoring/rater quality, certification, quality assurance, or a field involving complex, consequential judgments; experience aligning reviewers to a shared standard through calibration programs.</li> <li>Adult-learning program experience spanning onboarding, certification, ongoing training, remediation, and effectiveness measurement (beyond one-off materials).</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and strong judgment in ambiguous cases; ability to produce clear, defensible decisions and guidance.</li> <li>Analytical fluency to interpret quality data, disagreement patterns, and performance trends and translate them into practical interventions.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication; ability to turn complex standards into precise, usable guidance and explain difficult calls.</li> <li>Cross-functional leadership without formal authority; experience directing contractors or partners toward clear accountability and outcomes.</li> <li>Demonstrated skill in quality standards and rubric design, building living systems with decision logs, change histories, and controls for auditability.</li> <li>Experience defining quality benchmarks and validation methods for human–technology workflows, including AI-assisted processes.</li> <li>Adaptability — comfort revising standards and programs as risks, products, and technology change.</li> </ul> <p><strong>⭐&nbsp; Exceptional candidates will have...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in language assessment, test security, remote proctoring, trust and safety, or fraud prevention in high-integrity environments.</li> <li>Experience maintaining quality across large, distributed examiner/rater/reviewer/contractor populations.</li> <li>Familiarity with assessment concepts such as inter-rater agreement, reliability, standardization, and performance monitoring.</li> <li>Experience designing quality systems that span human judgment and technology-assisted workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with learning-management systems, assessment platforms, quality-audit tools, or operational analytics.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. Influence: Effective relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate and present confidently to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Operational Agility: A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.</li> <li>Collaborative Mindset: A team player who can work across functions to deliver complex, multi-layered projects.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us?</h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.</h2> <p>We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.</p> <p>This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.</p> <p>We are now looking for a <strong>Backend Engineer (Golang)</strong> to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.</p> <p>This role will be based in <strong>London</strong>, <strong>UK</strong> as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.</p> <h3>What you'll do:</h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.</li> <li>Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.</li> <li>Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.</li> <li>Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.</li> <li>Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.</li> <li>Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.</li> <li>Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.</li> </ul> <h2>Our expectations:</h2> <ul> <li>3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.</li> <li>1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.</li> <li>A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. title: Senior Marketing Advisor
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Clients and Marketing team are looking for an experienced Marketing Advisor to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>We’re building a professional Clients &amp; Marketing Function for the long term. The Marketing function at Baringa was set up in 2021, and the close-knit team has made real progress to build the marketing infrastructure at Baringa and professionalise our approach to Marketing. In 2025 it was extended and restructured as Clients &amp; Marketing, a broader function extending the remit to enable Baringa to better:</p> <ul> <li>Attract with Expertise</li> <li>Nurture enduring relationships</li> <li>Compete to win</li> <li>Understand client needs</li> <li>Negotiate for Value</li> </ul> <p>The Clients &amp; Marketing function acts as an internal agency for internal clients, working closely with partner sponsors and champions across Baringa. We work together to achieve our mutual objectives, including brand development, revenue generation, C-suite and LaG engagement, enhancing our digital presence, and supporting varied strategies aligned with our collective purpose. The role is UK remote, and we’ll cover reasonable travel expenses where face-to-face events or occasional team meetings in the office require attendance.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Work with the E&amp;R Marketing Business Partner to support the execution of E&amp;R marketing plans and deliverables.</li> <li>Play an integral role in delivering marketing strategies that align with sector goals and Baringa’s overall vision for Clients &amp; Marketing, while contributing to the broader business growth ambitions.</li> <li>Partner with E&amp;R teams and the E&amp;R Partner Clients &amp; Marketing Sponsor to align marketing efforts with business priorities, supporting structured and impactful go-to-market strategies.</li> <li>Help design, launch and manage global and regional campaigns to strengthen Baringa’s market positioning, adapting campaigns for local cultural and market needs across the UK, US, Europe and APAC.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop compelling campaign content such as thought leadership, client stories, videos, webinars and events.</li> <li>Apply Baringa’s agreed brand and AI story consistently across E&amp;R work - ensuring content credible and distinct, with support from the E&amp;R Marketing Business Partner.</li> <li>Act as a reliable link between E&amp;R and the wider Clients &amp; Marketing team: route work to the right experts, be clear with stakeholders about what C&amp;M can deliver and by when, and play a full part in shared planning.</li> <li>Support the development and planning of marketing campaigns, putting audience and market insight at the centre of decision-making to drive meaningful outcomes such as revenue growth, client acquisition and increased market share.</li> <li>Help identify Baringa’s unique strengths and differentiators to inform clear objectives, impactful messaging and effective targeting of key audiences and market segments.</li> <li>Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of the campaigns you are responsible for, from planning and execution to analysis and optimisation, taking a structured approach to ensure quality and results.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>CIM Diploma qualification or equivalent (or strong working knowledge of CIM principles preferred). Further certifications such as HubSpot, Google Analytics and/or data-driven marketing platforms are a plus.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in supporting marketing strategies and selecting innovative, data- driven tactics to drive business growth, enhance client engagement and support sales pipeline objectives.</li> <li>3+ years’ experience in B2B marketing, with a proven ability to help design and deliver impactful campaigns that achieve measurable business outcomes; professional services experience and familiarity with sector-specific challenges is welcomed.</li> <li>Ability to nurture relationships and navigate stakeholder environments - both internally across cross-functional teams and externally with partners and suppliers.</li> <li>Strong influencing skills and the ability to work effectively across levels of the organisation, including senior leadership, sector leads and diverse global teams.</li> <li>A proactive problem - solver, demonstrating resilience, adaptability and the ability to pre- empt, manage and resolve challenges as they arise.</li> <li>Self-driven and results-oriented, able to manage your own time and priorities - and coordinate others’ - while balancing short-term delivery with longer-term goals.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to foster an inclusive and high-performing environment.</li> <li>Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create compelling marketing content, presentations and messaging tailored to specific audiences.</li> <li>Curiosity and confidence in using Martech and marketing analytics tools - such as Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI and Google Analytics or equivalent&nbsp;</li> <li>Able to balance a strategic focus with detailed execution - owning and shaping projects from concept to completion with thorough planning, organisation and attention to detail.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Transition, Assets and Infrastructure practice are looking for an experienced Manager or Senior Manager to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>Our Asset &amp; Operations Excellence teams help energy, utilities and industrial clients get more from their physical assets – improving safety, reliability, availability and whole-life cost across the asset lifecycle. We combine deep asset management and engineering expertise with modern enterprise asset management technology and data to help clients move from reactive maintenance to intelligent, insight-led asset management. From shaping maintenance and reliability strategy to implementing platforms such as IBM Maximo and connecting operational technology (OT) with core information technology (IT), we help asset-intensive organisations run their networks and plant more safely, sustainably and cost-effectively.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You'll lead the design and delivery of asset management and operational transformations and improvement programs for asset-intensive clients across energy, utilities and major infrastructure companies – including current-state assessment and target operating model design through to implementation and adoption.</li> <li>You will help clients shift to risk/condition based and predictive maintenance strategies driving improvements in asset performance across the whole asset lifecycle.</li> <li>You'll lead providing advisory services related to and optimisation of EAM / CMMS platforms such as IBM Maximo – shaping user requirements, configuration, data migration and integrations with ERP, SCADA, condition monitoring platforms.</li> <li>You'll bring IT and OT together – defining how asset systems, data and cyber-security governance operate end-to-end, and establishing change control, data ownership (RACI) and support models that keep critical systems reliable and secure.</li> <li>You will help clients plan and shape the overall digital, technology, AI landscape for asset optimisation</li> <li>You'll manage day-to-day client relationships and, at Manager / Senior Manager level, hold commercial and delivery accountability for engagements – owning scope, risk, quality and margin.</li> <li>You'll build and coach high-performing teams, developing junior colleagues and creating an inclusive, People First environment.</li> <li>You'll help grow our rapidly expanding asset management and operations practice – shaping propositions, contributing to proposals and building trusted, lasting client relationships.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You've built your career in asset management or asset-intensive operations – in energy, utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing or a comparable sector – with a strong grounding in asset lifecycle management and maintenance and reliability principles.</li> <li>You've hands-on experience of Enterprise Asset Management and CMMS platforms such as IBM Maximo, (which may include implementation, configuration or product ownership)</li> <li>You understand how asset management systems connect to the wider technology landscape – ERP, SCADA, condition-based monitoring, data historians and asset / master data – and you can bridge IT and OT to make that ecosystem work.</li> <li>You've a strong appreciation of OT/IT integration and change governance – management of change, change control boards, data governance and RACI, and tiered (L1–L3) support models for critical asset systems.</li> <li>You've delivered change in a consulting, transformation or major-programme environment, comfortable owning workstreams, managing senior stakeholders and turning analysis into practical outcomes that stick.</li> <li>You've excellent analytical, communication and facilitation skills, and you're confident leading workshops and engaging senior client stakeholders.</li> <li>You will have an understanding on how emergent technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) is evolving in the asset management and operations arena. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-contrast="none">Our Solutions &amp; AI Labs (SAIL) practice is looking for an experienced Senior Manager to lead consultancy engagements and grow our AI &amp; Solutions Engineering capability.</span></strong></span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}">The AI/ML Senior Manager role will lead the delivery of AI-enabled solutions embedded in our clients' teams, combining deep technical<strong> </strong></span><span data-contrast="none">specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to grow and shape our practice.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client advisory, technical architecture and hands-on delivery leadership – and who has a genuine passion for bringing AI solutions to production at scale.</span> <span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our Solutions &amp; AI Labs (SAIL) practice focuses on helping clients control their data, turn it into actionable insights, and better leverage it&nbsp;through the use of&nbsp;AI and Machine Learning solutions directly embedded into business processes. We support clients across&nbsp;a number of&nbsp;industries and offer deep&nbsp;expertise&nbsp;in AI/ML, Cloud, Platform Engineering, and Managed Solutions.</span> <span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">What you will be doing</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:40}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a Senior Manager in SAIL, you will own and lead consultancy engagements end-to-end from shaping the opportunity and winning the work, through to delivery governance and team leadership. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">An award-winning workplace</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. </span><a href="https://www.baringa.com/en/impact/awards/"><span data-contrast="none">Click here</span></a><span data-contrast="none"> to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Using business as a force for good.</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act.
