title: Lead Data Products Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Energy Products practice are looking for an experienced Lead Data Products Engineer to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>Baringa are world leaders in modelling energy markets and using the insights generated through these models to drive change in a decarbonising energy industry. The Energy Products practice specialises in the development and innovation of our analytical models and supporting technology ecosystem underpinned by our deep expertise in the energy markets.</p> <p>Our staff come from diverse backgrounds, based across multiple geographies, and building models that utilise highly varied data sources – everything from kilobytes of academic papers to terabytes of hourly scenario projections for 50+ years. To ensure the ongoing success of our product development and manage the increasing complexity of our models, we are establishing a dedicated Data Products Team to curate, design and evolve the data products that underpin our modelling processes, analytics outputs and client-facing systems — working within our new internal Data and Processing Platform.</p> <p>Come and join us to be part of the energy transition, the defining challenge of our lifetimes, where your technical skills and experience can have real impact.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>We are looking for a Lead Data Products Engineer to lead the Data Products team, taking on a key role of engaging with Baringa subject matter experts to define, design and evolve data products within our new internal Data and Processing Platform that directly support our modelling processes and client-facing outputs.</p> <ul style="margin-top: 0in; margin-bottom: 0in;" type="disc"> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will build a deep understanding of our data domain, capturing our key data sources, how they flow into modelling processes, and how outputs are used in analytics and client-facing systems to ensure data products are designed to meet real demands</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will drive the design and development of foundational data products on our new Data Platform, collaborating closely with the Platform team to develop the data capture and transformation processes that produce them</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will own specific domain data products and their supporting processes, taking responsibility for their ongoing quality, adoption, reliability and evolution to support our modelling and analytics activities</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will formalise data contracts, owning the schemas, versioning strategy, data governance workflows and supporting backwards compatible interfaces</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will provide technical leadership to the team alongside the Product Owner, shaping data product design decisions and balancing commercial delivery priorities against long-term strategic goals</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will drive engineering best practices, ensuring that quality, reliability and observability are built in from inception</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 8pt; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will take an active role in all stages of the team's agile development approach, from refinement through to delivery, driving the iterative improvement of both our data products and our team processes</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span></span></h3> <ul> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You are passionate about data and its real-world application, with a drive to gain a deep understanding of the domain and modelling data products to genuinely serve the people who depend on them</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You will have practical experience as a senior or lead engineer in high-performing teams focused on the design and curation of data products, collaborating closely with domain experts and fellow engineers, and taking pride in what you create</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You are strong at solving complex problems and can flexibly consider different technologies/engineering approaches to achieve this</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You have strong experience working with Python for both Data and Application engineering and understand both domain modelling and application programming</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">You are passionate about communicating complex concepts succinctly to both technical and non-technical audiences to reach a common understanding</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0pt; If you think you are a good overall match please do get in touch – we look carefully at all applications, and you may well be our ideal candidate.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">8+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, ideally within marketplace, hospitality tech, or SaaS environments</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Proven track record of building inbound programs that generate measurable sales pipeline, including experience building a demand gen function from scratch (startup, scale-up, or new-business environment)</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation tools (MixMax, Outreach, or similar), and paid channels</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Strong analytical, systems-driven approach; comfortable running campaigns yourself, not just briefing others</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Data-driven: you own your funnel metrics and can connect campaign activity to revenue impact</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate campaigns and create content at scale</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Strong sales alignment instincts; additional European languages a plus</li> <li class="l19itp0p atm_gq_1wse94m dir dir-ltr">Experience operating globally across multiple regions/languages a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why This Role:</strong></p> <p>Airbnb Hotels is one of the company's highest-priority supply growth initiatives. This role sits at the center of that effort, with direct visibility to senior leadership and the ability to shape how the world's most recognized travel brand expands into professional hospitality.&nbsp;</p> <p>As the first person in this role, you'll help show what B2B demand generation can do for Airbnb Hotels. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media&nbsp;:</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.&nbsp;</em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.&nbsp;<br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&nbsp;<br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients.&nbsp;Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Au sein de l'équipe Data Tech &amp; Analytics (DTA), vous interviendrez en véritable support stratégique de la chaîne de valeur média (conseil, trading, tracking). Votre rôle consistera à accompagner les équipes d'experts dans l'optimisation de leur quotidien et de leurs processus. Vous participerez à la création d'outils et de tableaux de bord permettant de valoriser les données de campagnes pour le compte d'acteurs majeurs du e-commerce et des biens de grande consommation. Ce poste vous offrira l'opportunité de découvrir l'écosystème complet de la donnée marketing moderne (cloud, datalake, automatisation, APIs, IA) au sein d'un environnement stimulant et formateur.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Collecter et structurer</strong> les données médias issues de multiples sources afin de les centraliser efficacement au sein de nos bases de données.</li> <li><strong>Traiter et analyser</strong> les volumes de données recueillis en exploitant les environnements cloud et les langages de programmation adaptés pour en extraire des insights pertinents.</li> <li><strong>Concevoir et développer</strong> des tableaux de bord interactifs et des outils de restitution sur mesure pour faciliter la lecture des performances par les équipes d'experts.</li> <li><strong>Optimiser et simplifier</strong> les processus de reporting existants afin de fluidifier la communication et les échanges d'informations entre les différents pôles internes.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <p>Votre Expérience :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Bac +4/5 issu(e) d'une école d'ingénieur, d'une formation universitaire en Data ou d'une école de commerce avec une forte spécialisation en traitement de la donnée.</li> <li><strong>Expérience précédente :</strong> Une première expérience n'est pas obligatoire, mais la participation à des projets académiques concrets ou à des hackathons démontrant votre attrait pour la data est un véritable atout.</li> <li><strong>Secteur :</strong> Une forte appétence pour l'écosystème des médias, de la technologie et du marketing digital.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Compétences Techniques :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Maîtrise de l'anglais (niveau B2 minimum) indispensable pour interagir avec nos équipes globales et appréhender la documentation technique.</li> <li><strong>Bureautique/Outils :</strong> Maîtrise d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, manipulation de données) attendue et connaissance d'outils de data visualisation tels que Power BI serait apprécié.</li> <li><strong>Expertise métier :</strong> Solides bases en SQL requises et notions en Python. La connaissance d'environnements Cloud (AWS, GCP) ou de Data Warehouse est un plus apprécié.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Qualités Humaines :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Autonomie :</strong> Capacité à avancer de manière proactive sur vos projets et à prendre des initiatives tout en sachant solliciter votre équipe à bon escient.</li> <li><strong>Curiosité :</strong> Envie d'apprendre en continu, de vous auto-former sur de nouvelles technologies et de chercher des solutions innovantes par vous-même.</li> <li><strong>Rigueur :</strong> Souci du détail et précision dans le traitement et la restitution des données pour garantir la fiabilité des analyses fournies.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.</p> <p>While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €<strong>20k to </strong><strong>€</strong><strong>200k</strong>, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.</p> <p>Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world</strong>: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li>Your mantra is <strong>#alwaysbeprospecting</strong>: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.</li> <li><strong>You have innate curiosity in how businesses work</strong>: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You are a life-long learner</strong>: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.</li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers</strong>: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best:</strong> Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own your destiny:</strong> Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for <strong>80-90% net-new logo acquisition</strong> through self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Get In Early: </strong>The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Sharpen Your Edge:</strong> Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.</li> <li><strong>Navigate Complexity:</strong> Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>The Winning DNA:</strong> A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Verified Overachievement:</strong> A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We’ll want to see this on your resume.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Strategic Grit:</strong> Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.</li> <li><strong>Native French</strong> language</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also offers:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Intellectual Curiosity:</strong> You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.</li> <li><strong>A Repeatable Sales Framework:</strong> You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Minded Approach:</strong> You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Process Iteration:</strong> You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will take Alta Ares’ autonomous air-defense systems from the lab to the field, deploying, integrating, testing, troubleshooting and improving them alongside military operators and customers.

You will work at the intersection of Engineering, Product and Operations, across our interceptors, AI guidance, mission-management software, sensors and customer C2 systems.

This is not a traditional support role. You will own technical outcomes in real operational environments, often under time pressure and with incomplete information. You should be equally comfortable writing code, debugging systems, analysing telemetry and working directly with operators on a test range.

Deployment & Field Operations

  • Prepare and execute customer deployments, live-fire exercises, demonstrations and acceptance trials.

  • Deploy and validate Alta Ares systems, including interceptors, AI guidance and Cyclops mission-management capabilities.

  • Configure systems, networks and interfaces and execute test scenarios against defined success criteria.

  • Work directly with military operators, test teams, integrators and partners.

  • Troubleshoot issues rapidly in the field while maintaining safety and mission objectives.

  • Integrate Alta Ares systems with sensors, radars, C2 systems, networks and third-party platforms.

  • Develop scripts, configuration tools, APIs and integration components required for deployments.

  • Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Execute integration and acceptance testing across software, hardware, communications and system performance.

  • Diagnose issues across software, hardware, GNC, sensors, networking, communications, and operator workflows.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with strong operational judgment.

  • High ownership and able to solve ambiguous problems independently.

  • Strong communicator who can translate between operators and engineering teams.

  • Pragmatic, balancing speed, performance, safety and maintainability.

  • Comfortable with frequent travel and flexible hours during deployments and exercises.

  • Fluent English required; professional French strongly preferred.

  • High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive defense technologies.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment.

raw.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
  • Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
  • Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

    • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
    • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
    • Use Case / Practical Assessment : The use case will consist of a simple practical exercise focused on the alignment of an optical bench. The assessment will take place in the cleanroom, they are not considered PPE for this exercise.
    • Meeting with the teams
    • 2 reference check
    • Offer

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient quantum processing units that scale, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

With a team of more than 140 people, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and quantum algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation using Quandela's cutting-edge quantum dot technology.

Achieving this vision requires not only advances in photonic quantum computing, but also the development of scalable spin-photon interfaces, distributed entanglement capabilities and future SPOQC (Spin-Optical Quantum Computing) architectures that will enable modular and fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About this position:

Join Quandela’s Source Production team to work on the fiber pigtailing of single-photon sources.
The role focuses on developing, improving and operating highly precise fiber coupling methods for photonic quantum devices.

The role is part of the Source Production team, which currently includes 11 people across fabrication, fiber pigtailing and optical characterization. The role is part of the pigtail team, currently composed of one person, and works in close interaction with the fabrication and characterization teams.

The objective is to improve the reliability, reproducibility and productivity of the pigtailing process, from prototype development to production-ready methods.

  • Cool down pigtailed sources and support the validation of the assembled devices
  • Perform optical characterization of quantum emitters using quantum optics techniques, including single-photon detection
  • Contribute to the development of reliable and reproducible production procedures
  • Write systematic reports and share production feedback with other teams

  9. Improve productivity through AI and automation. Gather seller and leadership feedback, prioritize opportunities with GTM Systems, define requirements, pilot improvements and measure adoption, time saved and execution speed.

  10. Deliver cross-functional change. Represent EMEA in global initiatives and coordinate regional adoption with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Enablement and GTM Systems. Equip managers to embed improvements in daily execution.

  • Experience supporting multiple European markets.

  • Regional leaders have clear priorities backed by evidence and practical action plans.

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

Our Recognition :

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019.

The role

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for the engineer who will lead it.

As Engineering Manager for the Lini AI Platform, you will report directly to the Head of Engineering and lead a squad yet to be hired, fully focused on Lini initiatives. You will own both the technical quality and the human dimension of the team, from architecture decisions to individual growth plans.

A key part of the role is coordination: you sit at the intersection of ML, product, and feature engineering, and you are accountable for making those conversations productive.

We are looking for a senior engineer who grew into leadership and kept writing code (~30% of your time), while driving delivery, standards, and culture.

We also care about how you think about AI: whether you approach it as a design question as much as an engineering one, and whether you bring genuine curiosity and opinions into product conversations.

Missions :

  • Work in close collaboration with the ML team, Product Managers, and feature squads to define and ship Lini features
  • Translate model capabilities into product requirements, negotiate scope across teams, and clear cross-team dependencies before they become blockers
  • Lead code reviews, own the squad's engineering standards, and weigh in on architecture choices
  • Own delivery end-to-end: from scoping and planning to deployment and iteration, across all Lini-powered features in the DiliTrust Suite
  • Define and evolve the integration architecture of Lini across modules, including LLM connectors and context management
  • Partner with the Head of Engineering on cross-squad initiatives, technical roadmap, and hiring
  • Run regular 1:1s, provide structured feedback, and support each engineer's career development
  • Set and maintain engineering best practices: testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability

Requirements

Experience & seniority :
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • 3+ years managing an engineering team or squad in a product-oriented environment
  • Proven track record of owning technical decisions: architecture, scalability, code quality (not just managing the people making them)
  • Background at the intersection of AI or ML and product engineering: you know what it takes to go from a model capability to a production user experience
  • Proven ability to coordinate across multiple teams simultaneously (ML, product, engineering)
  • Fluent in French and English
Technical expertise :
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and Vue.js 3
  • Deep background in scalable web architectures and API design
  • Solid experience with LLM integration patterns in production (RAG, streaming, tool use, context management)
  • Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices in production
Leadership & collaboration :
  • Strong sense of ownership
  • Ability to build trust, create accountability, and grow engineers into senior roles
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You see AI as a design question as much as an integration challenge, and bring that thinking into product conversations
  • You engage with the product, bring ideas to the table, and consider yourself a stakeholder in the solutions your squad ships

Our Tech Stack

Backend: Node.js / TypeScript / Symfony
Frontend: Vue.js 3
AI/ML layer:  Python, internal models, LLM connectors
Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 

What we offer :

Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment (offices in France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Germany, USA, Mexico, Dubai...);
Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process :

    1. Interview with TA team member (30/45 mins)
    2. Interview with the Head of Engineering (1h)
    3. Technical interview (1h30 mins)
    4. Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

raw.description:
Senior Technical Program Manager, Paris

About Genesis
Genesis is a physical AI research lab and full-stack robotics company building a universal robotics foundation model (one AI "brain" that can power many kinds of robots) and a horizontal robotics platform. We work in San Francisco, Paris and London and combine large-scale AI research, an in-house physics simulation engine, and real robot hardware under one roof.

The role
You'll be the person who turns our most ambitious bets into shipped results. You'll sit between researchers, hardware engineers, software engineers and leadership, across two continents, making sure everyone knows what matters, who owns it and when it lands.

What you'll do

  • Drive cross-functional programs at the frontier of AI and robotics, from foundation model training to hardware–software integration, with pace and accountability

  • Turn ambitious goals into lean, unambiguous roadmaps: clear deliverables, clear owners, clear timelines

  • Dive into robotics hardware, software, simulation, and large-scale AI to understand trade-offs, surface uncertainties, and ask the questions others miss

  • Keep Bay Area and Paris teams tightly aligned, dependencies unblocked, and risks visible early

  • Build lightweight systems (roadmaps, metrics, dashboards) that keep execution focused on what matters

  • Leverage AI to build automated program management workflows, so status updates, risk tracking, and reporting run themselves and the team spends its time on real decisions

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years leading complex technical programs end-to-end in fast-moving environments (startup, research lab, or high-growth tech)

  • Enough technical fluency to hold a real conversation with an ML researcher about a training run and with a hardware engineer about an integration test, so you can challenge an estimate, spot a hidden dependency, or flag a risk before it becomes a delay

  • A track record of learning a new technical domain quickly and becoming useful in it within weeks, not months

  • Crisp, direct communication that aligns researchers, engineers, and leadership

  • Bias for action: many decisions can be reversed and you favor speed over endless analysis

  • Ownership: you own the outcome and drive the process to get tangible results

Bonus

  • Experience in robotics, hardware/software integration, or research workflows

  • Fluency in French

title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
description: About Nabla We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine. Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows. Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere. This is a great time to join us! The best of AI at the service of healthcare Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare. Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership. Engineering at Nabla Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale. Your Team At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership. As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product. What you'll do As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product. Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will: Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks. Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care. Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features. Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results. Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting. Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features. To get a sense of the impact you’ll have: Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs. By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes , saving 125 hours of doctor time . Your DNA: The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs. You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture. You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.). You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself. You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline. You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients. You communicate clearly and effectively. Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus. Our Stack Kotlin for backend services LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment Where you'll be based Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers) . Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year. Benefits Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work. Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla: Stock ownership 100% healthcare coverage Meal vouchers Public transportation costs covered at 50% Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time Life at Nabla When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed. We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes. We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts! If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application! Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Your Team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do

As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

  • Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks.

  • Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

  • Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features.

  • Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results.

  • Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting.

  • Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have:

  • Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

  • By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes, saving 125 hours of doctor time.

Your DNA:

The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs.

  • You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture.

  • You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.).

  • You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself.

  • You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline.

  • You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

Our Stack

  • Kotlin for backend services

  • LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves

  • Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents

  • Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time

  • Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers).
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution.

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where consultants are expected to think critically, take ownership early, work directly with senior stakeholders and contribute to building long-term client impact.

The role

As an Engagement Manager - Business & AI Transformation, you will lead complex transformation engagements for clients facing critical strategic, operational and organisational challenges.

You will combine strategic thinking, product expertise and hands-on execution to translate business needs into high-impact transformation initiatives. Working at the intersection of business, product, technology, data and AI, you will help clients transform functions, teams, operating models and ways of working while ensuring that solutions create measurable and sustainable value.

You will lead taskforces composed of strategy consultants and senior digital experts located across France and the UK, with the support of a Principal or Partner.

What you will do ?

Lead transformation engagements

  • Lead business, product, technology, data and AI transformation programmes from initial framing through execution and closing.
  • Structure the problem, define the overall approach and organise the engagement into clear workstreams.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives and concrete delivery plans.
  • Combine strategic analysis, product thinking and operational execution to accelerate impact.
  • Support the identification, prototyping, prioritisation and deployment of high-value solutions where relevant.
  • Drive problem-solving and analyses while maintaining a high level of quality and strategic coherence.
  • Ensure that transformation initiatives deliver tangible business outcomes and sustainable improvements in performance.

Lead clients and stakeholders

  • Manage the day-to-day client relationship with senior and C-level stakeholders.
  • Facilitate workshops, decision-making sessions and alignment discussions across business, product and technology teams.
  • Translate between business priorities, operational requirements and technical possibilities.
  • Handle complex queries and challenges with confidence and pragmatism.
  • Navigate complex, political and multi-stakeholder environments successfully.
  • Build trust with clients by combining strategic perspective, delivery discipline and a strong focus on outcomes.

Own project delivery

  • Lead projects from execution to closing, ensuring that timelines, milestones and team responsibilities remain on track.
  • Manage resources, team capacity and end-products while contributing to project profitability.
  • Participate in setting up the appropriate team of strategy consultants and digital experts.
  • Ensure the quality, consistency and executive-readiness of all key deliverables.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment with the client and the Singulier leadership team.
  • Ensure the appropriate capitalisation of project knowledge, methodologies and reusable assets.

Contribute to business development

  • Contribute to building proposals and responding to client opportunities with the support of Partners, Principals, Directors and practice leaders.
  • Help shape the problem statement, transformation approach, workplan, team structure and commercial scope.
  • Identify opportunities to extend client relationships and support the growth of Singulier’s transformation offering.
  • Bring innovative ideas to proposals, client presentations and problem-solving discussions.
  • Contribute to the development of Singulier’s market positioning and thought leadership on business, product, technology, data and AI transformation.

Develop people and build the firm

  • Lead and develop teams of consultants and digital experts across engagements.
  • Coach Consultants, Analysts and junior team members, helping them build both consulting and transformation capabilities.
  • Provide clear direction, feedback and support throughout projects.
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, methodology development, knowledge sharing and recruitment.
  • Help strengthen the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of Singulier.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • 4–5+ years of experience in a strategy, digital, product, technology or business transformation consulting firm.
  • Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes in environments involving multiple stakeholders.
  • The ability to combine strategic vision, structured problem-solving and operational execution.
  • Experience working across business, product, technology, data or AI topics.
  • A strong understanding of how technology, data and AI can transform business functions, operating models and ways of working.
  • Experience translating business needs into transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives or actionable delivery plans.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, resources and deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with confidence operating at senior and C-level.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly.
  • Demonstrated commercial abilities and an interest in contributing to proposals and business development.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with the autonomy, pragmatism and proactivity required to thrive in a fast-growing environment.
  • Fluency in both French and English is required.

Benefits

title: Head of Hospitals & Home Care
description: <h2><strong>Qui sommes-nous ?</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. Avec 2 900 collaborateurs en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et aux Pays-Bas, nous accompagnons plus de 420 000 professionnels de santé et 90 millions de patients, transformant l'accès aux soins et la prise en charge à travers l'Europe. Nous accélérons désormais notre ambition : devenir le partenaire clinique de référence en Europe, de confiance pour les patients et les professionnels, grâce à la puissance de technologies avancées et de l'IA.</p> <p>Notre ambition est de construire le système d'exploitation clinique de demain pour l'Europe - offrant des résultats de santé mesurables pour des millions de personnes.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Pour les professionnels de santé </strong>: Nous réduisons la charge administrative, augmentons la prise de décision clinique grâce à l'IA et permettons de nouveaux modèles de soins.</li> <li><strong>Pour les patients</strong> : Nous passons de soins réactifs en cas de maladie à une gestion proactive de leur santé, en donnant aux personnes les moyens de prendre en charge leur santé avec des compagnons numériques de confiance, recommandés par les médecins.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Vos missions</strong></h2> <p>L'hôpital est l'un des segments les plus stratégiques et exigeants de Doctolib. En une décennie, nous avons construit une présence solide auprès des établissements de santé, publics et privés à but non lucratif, avec une suite complète de solutions couvrant l'ensemble du parcours ambulatoire : visibilité de l'offre de soins, planification, prise de rendez-vous, préparation administrative, assistant de consultation IA, téléconsultation, téléexpertise et bien plus encore.</p> <p>En tant que Head of Hospitals &amp; Home Care, vous prenez la tête d'une équipe d'une quinzaine de personnes, structurée en acquisition et account management, et appuyée par de nombreuses équipes expertes partenaires, notamment Déploiement, Interopérabilité, Product Marketing et Affaires Publiques. Vous êtes le ou la garant(e) de la performance commerciale, de la satisfaction client et de la vision stratégique du segment hospitalier en France, tout en ouvrant la voie à de nouveaux territoires : le médico-social et les soins à domicile.</p> <p>Votre responsabilité sera de combiner performance à court terme, développement de la base installée et construction d'une vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans pour le segment.</p> <p>Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Salaried &amp; Retail France de Doctolib, en reportant à Maric Philibert, notre VP Sales, Salaried &amp; Retail.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et atteindre les objectifs de net MRR du segment, sur l'acquisition, l'expansion et la rétention, avec une implication personnelle dans le développement des comptes les plus stratégiques et l'accélération du cross-sell sur les nouvelles solutions, notamment l'Assistant de Consultation et la Téléexpertise.</li> <li>Assurer la satisfaction et l'usage effectif des solutions Doctolib dans les établissements clients, en coordination étroite avec les équipes Déploiement, Interopérabilité et Customer Care.</li> <li>Manager, développer et engager une équipe d'environ 15 personnes, accompagner sa montée en séniorité et renforcer son efficacité grâce à la donnée et aux agents IA.</li> <li>Construire et incarner la vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans du segment, en lien avec la Product Vision de Doctolib et les tendances de marché, en coordination avec les équipes Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques, Communication et Produit.</li> <li>Développer et entretenir les relations institutionnelles clés, notamment avec la FHF, la FEHAP, UNICANCER, la DGOS et les ARS, et piloter les partenariats stratégiques du segment.</li> <li>Explorer et initier les premiers revenus dans les segments médico-social et soins à domicile, en définissant les besoins, la stratégie et les approches tactiques adaptées.</li> <li>Développer une approche structurée de segmentation, d'account planning et de couverture des comptes stratégiques, afin d'augmenter l'adoption, l'expansion, le cross-sell et la rétention.</li> <li>Coordonner les équipes Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats, tout en gardant les priorités clients et terrain au centre des décisions.</li> <li>Représenter Doctolib auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs, institutionnels, politiques, techniques et des principaux réseaux professionnels du secteur.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Votre impact</strong></h2> <p>Au cours des 12 premiers mois, vous aurez établi un diagnostic clair et un plan opérationnel pour le segment, renforcé l'équipe et les managers, amélioré la visibilité sur la performance et créé une nouvelle dynamique autour des comptes stratégiques et des opportunités de croissance.</p> <p>À deux à cinq ans, la réussite se traduira notamment par :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Faire progresser le revenu et doubler la croissance</strong> en new ARR annuel via l’upsell (licences des solutions historiques), le cross sell (livraison de solutions autour de l’IA et de la coordination des soins) ainsi que l’acquisition de nouveaux clients dans les segments hospitaliers sous-exploités aujourd’hui , le médico-social, les EHPAD et les soins à domicile.</li> <li><strong>Positionner Doctolib comme une solution complète</strong>, de confiance et créatrice de valeur pour les établissements de santé, dans une approche plus partenariale et moins transactionnelle, et accompagner les mouvements de fond du secteur : du curatif au préventif, vers plus de coordination entre professionnels de tous types, la responsabilité populationnelle</li> <li><strong>Construire une équipe stable, plus senior et soutenue par les agents IA</strong>, donc en capacité de vendre et d’assurer la satisfaction pour plus de solutions et plus d’établissements, moins dépendante des expertises individuelles.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Profil recherché</strong></h2> <p>Nous recherchons un leader senior capable d'agir comme le ou la CEO du segment et d'évoluer avec crédibilité auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs internes et externes.</p> <ul> <li>Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative auprès d'établissements de santé, acquise comme fournisseur ou prestataire, éditeur e-santé, acteur de la healthtech, dirigeant d'établissement ou de groupe, institutionnel ou consultant en santé avec une forte dimension commerciale. Vous comprenez les acteurs, les personas, les cultures, les rythmes, les circuits de décision et les enjeux politiques et réglementaires du secteur.</li> <li>Vous avez une expérience de la vente B2B complexe et grands comptes, avec des organisations comprenant de nombreuses parties prenantes et des cycles de vente longs. Vous maîtrisez l'acquisition, la vente de solutions complexes, la gestion de comptes stratégiques, l'expansion, l'adoption et la rétention.</li> <li>Vous apportez une vision business 360° couvrant la stratégie, le go-to-market, l'acquisition, l'expansion, les partenariats, le produit, les opérations et l'account management, sans angle mort.</li> <li>Vous avez managé et développé une organisation d'au moins 10 personnes, idéalement composée de profils hétérogènes, avec un historique de transformation, de montée en séniorité et de développement de managers.</li> <li>Vous savez délivrer des résultats à court terme tout en construisant le segment à moyen et long terme, avec rigueur analytique, gravitas C-level et excellente coordination transverse avec Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats.</li> <li>Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ce serait un plus si vous aviez aussi :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une expérience des acteurs du médico-social, des EHPAD ou des soins à domicile, ou une forte motivation pour contribuer activement à l'ouverture de ces marchés.</li> <li>Une About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. 3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.
